records.title: WHO intensified smallpox eradication as surveillance-plus-vaccination system
records.sourceNativeSummary: WHO’s 1967 intensified programme combined vaccination with surveillance, case finding, containment, vaccine quality and international logistics; eradication performance depended on an operational public-health system rather than vaccine existence alone.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Mass vaccination coverage by itself was not sufficient in all settings; surveillance/containment and stable freeze-dried vaccine/infrastructure were separate enabling conditions.

sources.supports: 1959/1967 programme history, freeze-dried vaccine, global cooperation

records.title: Scribner shunt and chronic hemodialysis as a durable treatment system
records.sourceNativeSummary: The 1960 Scribner shunt enabled repeated vascular access, converting dialysis from an acute/one-off intervention into a chronic treatment possibility and leading to outpatient dialysis centers.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Technical chronic-treatment feasibility immediately exposed scarce-machine/selection/financing problems; keeping a patient alive repeatedly is a service-allocation system, not only a device success.

sources.supports: 1960 Scribner shunt, repeated vascular access and 1962 outpatient dialysis center

records.title: Wearable and implantable cardiac pacemakers enabled by electronics miniaturization
records.sourceNativeSummary: External pacing worked but tethered patients to bulky equipment; transistorized battery electronics enabled wearable pacemakers in 1958 and successful implantable devices by 1960.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Miniaturization solved mobility/implantability while battery life, lead reliability, surgery and device regulation remained distinct lifecycle risks.

records.title: Tokaido Shinkansen as a purpose-built high-speed rail system
records.sourceNativeSummary: The Tokaido Shinkansen opened Tokyo–Osaka service in 1964 using a dedicated high-speed line/system, avoiding many constraints of mixed conventional tracks and coupling rolling stock, signaling, operations and infrastructure.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Top speed alone does not define the service: dedicated right-of-way, timetable, maintenance, capacity and safety operations are part of the realized high-speed system.

sources.supports: dedicated infrastructure, 1964 opening and system-level performance

records.title: Boeing 707 and jet-age civil air transport
records.sourceNativeSummary: Boeing privately developed the Dash 80 prototype in 1954; the 707 entered service in 1958 and combined jet propulsion, range, airline requirements and an economically productive passenger layout, accelerating mass jet travel.
records.rivalOrBoundary: Jet propulsion was not sufficient: cabin width, airport/route economics, reliability and airline orders shaped commercial viability; earlier jet airliners existed but occupied different reliability/economic regimes.

sources.supports: Dash 80 investment, Pan Am requirements and 707 service/economics

records.title: Keeling Mauna Loa CO2 record as long-lived environmental observation
records.sourceNativeSummary: Keeling began precise continuous CO2 measurements at Mauna Loa in 1958; the sustained calibrated record separated seasonal variation from a persistent atmospheric increase and became a benchmark long-term Earth observation.
records.rivalOrBoundary: A long, trusted trend required site selection, calibration discipline and continuity of funding; isolated measurements or a short run could not establish the same global temporal claim.

sources.supports: 1958 Mauna Loa record and longest direct atmospheric CO2 series
measurement-error control, continuity and long-term observation lessons

records.title: Pilkington float glass from process experiment to continuous industrial manufacture
records.sourceNativeSummary: Pilkington’s team experimented from 1952 through years of flawed output before producing saleable continuous float glass and announcing the process in 1959; the method combined high surface quality with continuous sheet production.
records.rivalOrBoundary: A clever principle did not imply industrial closure: continuous 24/7 quality, bath chemistry, thickness control and line reliability required years of process development.

sources.supports: 1952–1959 experiments, continuous quality and commercial announcement
independent licensee history of float-process development and diffusion
